Changes how the Test number presents itself. A change unlinks every companion, including the Number's own session, so each must pair again. Repeating the current mode changes nothing.

id.description: Opaque Polymorfa resource ID. Keep this value as a string.

encryption.description: How messages with this business are encrypted, as WhatsApp reports it. Omitted when the connection does not report it.

x-enumDescriptions.hybrid: Some of the business's messaging uses a service that is not end-to-end encrypted, such as a hosting provider.
x-enumDescriptions.not_end_to_end: Messages with this business are not end-to-end encrypted.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-Id response header. Include it when you contact support.

request_log_url.description: Console page that shows this request. Returned only to organization and project credentials whose request was logged.

data.description: Always null for a failed request.

signalMode.description: Signal key custody for a new Number. Inherits Customer then Project default; cannot change an existing Number. Customer-owned custody requires beta admission and real Linked Devices.

purpose.description: Initial setup, or add a transport to an existing session without replacing the Number.

session.description: Existing session name. Required only for add_connection.

projectId.description: Project that receives the connected number. Required for team keys with more than one project.

customerId.description: Customer that owns the connected number when Customers is enabled for the project.

billingControls.description: Initial monthly spending limit and funding priority for a real Number. Requires a team key with billing:manage or a live team owner/admin on Pay-As-You-Go. Applied atomically before pairing admission.

externalId.description: Integrator correlation copied to the resulting session. May repeat across invitations; does not grant access.

primaryPlatform.description: Primary phone platform the Test number emulates. Defaults to `android`. Not accepted when `accountType` is `meta_cloud`.

methods.description: Linked Devices methods offered for this connection.

defaultMethod.description: Linked Devices method opened first. Omit to inherit the saved project setting, or set null to choose by recipient device.

delivery.description: Polymorfa-Version 2026-10-14 and later. `descriptor` keeps history chunks with the recipient for local processing. Omit to inherit saved defaults. Recipient history consent remains required.

url.description: Hosted connection URL. Share it only with the person holding the phone.

session.description: Session name that receives the connected number.

expiresAt.description: Null for new persistent QuickLinks. Legacy links retain their ISO-8601 expiry.
